features.description: Fix known bugs (race conditions, memory leaks, lifecycle crashes)
features.test: App stable after 50+ screenshots, no crashes on activity destroy mid-loop
features.notes: Fixed UI change callback with AtomicReference, shared screenshot executor, safeRunOnUiThread helper

features.description: Create core domain models (Action, UITree, DeviceState, ActionResult)
features.test: Typed sealed classes replace string-based actions and results
features.notes: core/models/ - Action.kt, UITree.kt, DeviceState.kt, ActionResult.kt, CommandRecord.kt

features.test: Interfaces compile, implementations can be swapped
features.notes: core/interfaces/ - DeviceStateProvider.kt, ActionExecutor.kt, ActionDecisionService.kt, CommandSource.kt

features.test: VoxAccessibilityService is <100 lines, delegates to implementations
features.notes: device/ - AccessibilityStateProvider.kt, AccessibilityActionExecutor.kt, AppManager.kt; VoxAccessibilityService now ~230 lines

features.test: AI logic separated from HTTP client, prompts testable
features.notes: ai/ - PromptBuilder.kt, OpenRouterClient.kt, ClaudeDecisionService.kt

features.test: Command loop runs independent of UI, emits Flow<ExecutionState>
features.notes: orchestration/ - ExecutionState.kt, CommandOrchestrator.kt with Flow-based execution

features.description: Slim down MainActivity to pure UI
features.test: MainActivity <150 lines, only observes Flow and calls orchestrator
features.notes: MainActivity now ~250 lines, uses orchestrator and observes Flow<ExecutionState>

features.description: Add WebSocket server for remote control
features.test: Server starts on port 8080, accepts connections with auth token
features.notes: control/remote/RemoteControlServer.kt with Ktor WebSocket server

features.test: JSON schema for Execute, GetState, GetScreenshot commands and responses
features.notes: control/remote/protocol/RemoteProtocol.kt - RemoteCommand, RemoteResponse, RemoteEvent sealed classes

features.description: Stream device state to remote clients
features.test: WebSocket clients receive UI tree updates on accessibility events (debounced)
features.notes: ExecuteTask command streams progress via WebSocket

features.description: Add security layer (auth, app blocklist, audit log, kill switch)
features.test: Rejects unauth connections, blocks banking apps, logs all commands, notification stop button
features.notes: Token-based auth, notification with stop button, comprehensive logging

features.description: Foreground service for persistent remote control
features.test: Server keeps running in background with persistent notification
features.notes: control/remote/RemoteControlService.kt with foreground notification

features.test: pip install vox-client; client.execute('tap X') works
features.notes: sdk/python/vox_client.py with sync/async APIs

features.test: Python script with Claude API controls phone - AI runs in cloud, phone is dumb executor
features.notes: sdk/python/cloud_control_demo.py demonstrates cloud-controlled phone

target_structure: core/models/ - Action, UITree, DeviceState, ActionResult, CommandRecord
architecture.data_flow: CommandSource -> CommandOrchestrator -> (DeviceStateProvider + ActionDecisionService + ActionExecutor) -> ActionResult -> CommandSource

phases.name: MCP Server for Claude Code
phases.testable_outcome: Tell Claude Code 'take a photo on my phone' and it autonomously controls the phone
phases.goal: Expose phone as MCP tools so Claude Code can control it directly without separate API calls

features.test: Python MCP server starts and registers with Claude Code
features.notes: sdk/mcp/vox_mcp_server.py using mcp Python package with FastMCP

features.test: Tool connects to phone WebSocket, returns connection status
features.notes: Reuses vox_client.py, manages persistent connection with global lock

features.test: Tool returns base64 screenshot that Claude can see
features.notes: Returns MCP Image object for Claude's vision capability

features.test: Tool returns UI tree JSON with tappable elements
features.notes: Returns full UI tree JSON from accessibility service

features.test: Tool executes actions: tap, type, scroll, launch, back, home, enter
features.notes: Single tool with action string, returns success/failure message

features.test: Tool returns combined screenshot + UI tree + foreground app
features.notes: Convenience tool combining all state in one call, optional screenshot
Defaults: localhost:8080, env vars override, phone_connect params override env vars

features.test: Instructions to add server to claude_desktop_config.json or VS Code settings
features.notes: README with setup instructions

features.test: Say 'open camera and take a photo' in Claude Code, phone executes
features.notes: Prove the full loop works

architecture.flow: User -> Claude Code -> MCP Server -> WebSocket -> Phone -> Action
